note: Nov 5 2026, hand re-cut of the rebuilt Nov 5 03:34 auto cut, after Patrick heard awkward spots where Priyanka tried to change direction or close. The auto cut ran one piece from 63.6 to 2131.8 s and its own rationale claimed four repeat loops were removed; none were. Out now: Mira's duplicated question and the stray 'point' at her session rescue (253.9-292.2); three 'can you repeat the question' loops (693-719, 1080.6-1092.5, 1322-1341.6); Mira's three unanswered questions while Priyanka was steering with the panel (1764.5-1858.3); and everything after 'living in that has made us at peace' (2011.8-), which is her advice to a new PhD with 'I'd like to wrap up the interview now' in the same breath, Mira's garbled goodbye, 'Can you repeat that question? I'm not sure if that was a question', 'It wasn't', and two more questions she had asked to end before. Every boundary sits in a silence between the voiced spans the Nov 5 build measured (tracks.edit.clock); times are on the room clock.

cuts.text: We need to always be the ones on the truck.
